\* qcap: current queue capacity (retuned at runtime, enforcing backpressure);
\* owner: worker holding the exclusive catalog lock; inCS: workers in section.

    /\ qcap \in CapLevels

    /\ qcap \in CapLevels

Enqueue ==
    /\ queue < qcap
    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qcap, owner, inCS>>

\* A worker acquires the exclusive lock on the shared catalog.
Acquire(w) ==

Release(w) ==

    /\ ~inCS[w]
    /\ owner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, qcap, inCS>>

    \/ \E w \in Workers : Acquire(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Enter(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Service(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Release(w)

\* lock has a single owner, at most one worker is ever in the section.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m7p5t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Drones, Targets

VARIABLES mission, done, struckBy, pending, base, alive
\* mission: shared compare-and-swap mission counter; done: targets whose
\* irreversible strike has committed; struckBy: the drone that struck each
\* target; pending: target each drone is committing; base: mission value each
\* drone read; alive: drones not yet crashed.

vars == <<mission, done, struckBy, pending, base, alive>>

None == "none"
MaxV == 2

TypeOK ==
    /\ mission \in 0..MaxV
    /\ done \subseteq Targets
    /\ struckBy \in [Targets -> Drones \cup {None}]
    /\ pending \in [Drones -> Targets \cup {None}]
    /\ base \in [Drones -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ alive \in [Drones -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ mission = 0
    /\ done = {}
    /\ struckBy = [t \in Targets |-> None]
    /\ pending = [d \in Drones |-> None]
    /\ base = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ alive = [d \in Drones |-> TRUE]

\* A live drone reads the shared counter and targets an un-struck objective.
Read(d, t) ==
    /\ alive[d]
    /\ pending[d] = None
    /\ t \notin done
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![d] = t]
    /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![d] = mission]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mission, done, struckBy, alive>>

\* The strike commits by compare-and-swap (counter unchanged since the read).
\* Committing is irreversible: it records the striker and advances the counter.
Commit(d) ==
    /\ alive[d]
    /\ pending[d] # None
    /\ base[d] = mission
    /\ mission < MaxV
    /\ pending[d] \notin done
    /\ LET t == pending[d] IN
        /\ done' = done \cup {t}
        /\ struckBy' = [struckBy EXCEPT ![t] = d]
    /\ mission' = mission + 1
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![d] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<base, alive>>

\* A stale compare-and-swap (counter moved) is dropped.
Drop(d) ==
    /\ alive[d]
    /\ pending[d] # None
    /\ base[d] # mission
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![d] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mission, done, struckBy, base, alive>>

\* At most one drone may crash silently.
Crash(d) ==
    /\ alive[d]
    /\ \A e \in Drones : alive[e]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mission, done, struckBy, pending, base>>

\* A struck objective is recycled; the striker record is cleared with it, and
\* the counter resets only once no struck objectives remain.
Recycle(t) ==
    /\ t \in done
    /\ done' = done \ {t}
    /\ struckBy' = [struckBy EXCEPT ![t] = None]
    /\ mission' = IF done' = {} THEN 0 ELSE mission
    /\ base' = IF done' = {} THEN [d \in Drones |-> 0] ELSE base
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, alive>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones, t \in Targets : Read(d, t)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Commit(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Drop(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Crash(d)
    \/ \E t \in Targets : Recycle(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A target is recorded as struck by exactly one drone precisely when it is in
\* the done set; the compare-and-swap commit guard ensures no target is struck
\* twice, so every irreversible strike is attributable to a single drone.
StruckOnce == \A t \in Targets : (t \in done) <=> (struckBy[t] # None)
=============================================================================
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm coordinates irreversible retardant strikes through a shared compare-and-swap mission counter. A live drone reads the current counter value and picks an objective that has not yet been struck. It commits its strike by compare-and-swap: the strike succeeds only if the counter has not moved since the read; committing is irreversible, records which drone struck the objective, and advances the shared counter. Because the commit is guarded against objectives already struck, no objective is struck twice. If the counter has moved -- another drone struck in the meantime -- the compare-and-swap is stale and the attempt is dropped. Any single drone may crash silently and stop participating, but at most one drone is lost. A struck objective is eventually recycled for a fresh survey pass: its striker record is cleared with it, and the shared counter resets only once no struck objectives remain.

The actions are: a live drone reads the counter and picks an un-struck objective, a drone commits its strike by compare-and-swap (irreversibly recording the striker and advancing the counter), a drone drops a stale attempt, at most one drone crashes silently, and a struck objective is recycled (clearing its striker record).

SAFETY PROPERTY: A target is recorded as struck by exactly one drone precisely when it is in the done set, and the commit guard ensures no target is struck twice, so every irreversible strike is attributable to a single drone and happens at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m3p0t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers

VARIABLES leader, candidate, votes, inCS, override
\* leader: elected controller holding the runway (or none); candidate: current
\* nominee; votes: who has voted for the nominee; inCS: controllers using the
\* runway; override: whether the admin override is engaged.

vars == <<leader, candidate, votes, inCS, override>>

None == "none"
Quorum == 2
VoteCount == Cardinality({c \in Controllers : votes[c]})

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Controllers \cup {None}
    /\ candidate \in Controllers \cup {None}
    /\ votes \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ inCS \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ candidate = None
    /\ votes = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]
    /\ inCS = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]
    /\ override = FALSE

\* Nominate a candidate when there is no leader.
Nominate(c) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ candidate = None
    /\ candidate' = c
    /\ votes' = [k \in Controllers |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, inCS, override>>

\* A controller votes for the nominee.
CastVote(c) ==
    /\ candidate # None
    /\ ~votes[c]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, candidate, inCS, override>>

\* With a quorum of votes the nominee becomes leader.
Elect ==
    /\ candidate # None
    /\ VoteCount >= Quorum
    /\ leader' = candidate
    /\ candidate' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, inCS, override>>

\* Only the leader may take the runway (critical section).
Enter(c) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ ~inCS[c]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, candidate, votes, override>>

\* Leave the runway.
Exit(c) ==
    /\ inCS[c]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, candidate, votes, override>>

\* The leader fails over: it relinquishes the runway and leadership together.
Failover ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![leader] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<candidate, votes, override>>

\* Under admin override, the operator force-appoints a leader, first clearing
\* the runway so no stale user remains.
AdminAppoint(c) ==
    /\ override
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ candidate' = None
    /\ inCS' = [k \in Controllers |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, override>>

\* The admin override is toggled.
ToggleOverride ==
    /\ override' = ~override
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, candidate, votes, inCS>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Nominate(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : CastVote(c)
    \/ Elect
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Exit(c)
    \/ Failover
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : AdminAppoint(c)
    \/ ToggleOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Anyone using the runway is the current leader; since there is a single
\* leader at a time, at most one controller ever holds the runway.
MutualExclusion == \A c \in Controllers : inCS[c] => leader = c

An air-traffic runway allocator grants exclusive use of a single runway to one elected controller at a time, using leader election with failover. When there is no leader, a controller is nominated; the other controllers vote, and once a quorum has voted the nominee becomes the leader. Only the leader may take the runway as its critical section, and it leaves the runway when done. The leader may fail over at any time, relinquishing both the runway and its leadership in the same step, after which a new leader can be elected. A privileged admin override lets a human operator force-appoint a leader directly, bypassing the election; to keep the runway safe, forcing an appointment first clears the runway so no stale user remains. The override can be toggled on and off. Because there is only ever a single leader, the runway is never used by two controllers at once.

The actions are: nominate a candidate when leaderless, cast a vote for the nominee, elect the nominee on a quorum, the leader enters the runway, a controller leaves the runway, the leader fails over (dropping the runway and leadership), the admin force-appoints a leader (clearing the runway), and toggle the admin override.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any controller using the runway is the current leader, and since there is only one leader at a time, at most one controller ever holds the runway.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m8p2t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Courses

VARIABLES free, used, level, fineCourse, override
\* free/used: free and occupied seats per course (they sum to the fixed cap);
\* level: registrar lock level (idle/coarse/fine); fineCourse: the fine-locked
\* course; override: whether the admin override is engaged.

vars == <<free, used, level, fineCourse, override>>

Cap == 3
None == "none"

TypeOK ==
    /\ free \in [Courses -> 0..Cap]
    /\ used \in [Courses -> 0..Cap]
    /\ level \in {"idle", "coarse", "fine"}
    /\ fineCourse \in Courses \cup {None}
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ free = [c \in Courses |-> Cap]
    /\ used = [c \in Courses |-> 0]
    /\ level = "idle"
    /\ fineCourse = None
    /\ override = FALSE

\* Take the coarse registrar lock.
LockCoarse ==
    /\ level = "idle"
    /\ level' = "coarse"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, used, fineCourse, override>>

\* Take a fine lock on a specific course.
LockFine(c) ==
    /\ level = "coarse"
    /\ fineCourse = None
    /\ fineCourse' = c
    /\ level' = "fine"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, used, override>>

\* Enroll: one seat moves from free to used under the fine lock.
Enroll(c) ==
    /\ level = "fine"
    /\ fineCourse = c
    /\ free[c] > 0
    /\ free' = [free EXCEPT ![c] = free[c] - 1]
    /\ used' = [used EXCEPT ![c] = used[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<level, fineCourse, override>>

\* Drop: one seat moves from used back to free under the fine lock.
Drop(c) ==
    /\ level = "fine"
    /\ fineCourse = c
    /\ used[c] > 0
    /\ used' = [used EXCEPT ![c] = used[c] - 1]
    /\ free' = [free EXCEPT ![c] = free[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<level, fineCourse, override>>

\* Drop the fine lock.
UnlockFine ==
    /\ level = "fine"
    /\ level' = "coarse"
    /\ fineCourse' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, used, override>>

\* Drop the coarse lock.
UnlockCoarse ==
    /\ level = "coarse"
    /\ level' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, used, fineCourse, override>>

\* Under admin override the registrar enrolls a seat bypassing the lock stack.
AdminEnroll(c) ==
    /\ override
    /\ free[c] > 0
    /\ free' = [free EXCEPT ![c] = free[c] - 1]
    /\ used' = [used EXCEPT ![c] = used[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<level, fineCourse, override>>

\* Under admin override the registrar drops a seat bypassing the lock stack.
AdminDrop(c) ==
    /\ override
    /\ used[c] > 0
    /\ used' = [used EXCEPT ![c] = used[c] - 1]
    /\ free' = [free EXCEPT ![c] = free[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<level, fineCourse, override>>

\* Toggle the admin override.
ToggleOverride ==
    /\ override' = ~override
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, used, level, fineCourse>>

Next ==
    \/ LockCoarse
    \/ \E c \in Courses : LockFine(c)
    \/ \E c \in Courses : Enroll(c)
    \/ \E c \in Courses : Drop(c)
    \/ UnlockFine
    \/ UnlockCoarse
    \/ \E c \in Courses : AdminEnroll(c)
    \/ \E c \in Courses : AdminDrop(c)
    \/ ToggleOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every enroll or drop only moves a seat between free and used, so each
\* course's free plus used seats always equals its fixed capacity.
Conserved == \A c \in Courses : free[c] + used[c] = Cap
=============================================================================

Enrollment changes are serialized with hierarchical locks: the registrar takes a coarse registrar-wide lock, then a fine lock on a specific course, before it may enroll or drop within that course. Enrolling moves one seat from free to used; dropping moves one seat from used back to free -- seats are only ever moved, never created or destroyed. The registrar unwinds its locks in reverse order. A privileged admin override lets an operator enroll or drop a seat directly, bypassing the lock stack, but even the override only moves a seat between free and used, preserving the seat count. The override can be toggled on and off.

The actions are: take the coarse lock, take a fine lock on a course, enroll a seat under the fine lock, drop a seat under the fine lock, drop the fine lock, drop the coarse lock, admin-enroll a seat bypassing the locks, admin-drop a seat bypassing the locks, and toggle the admin override.
